sources.name: GameTrek
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide: All 55 Achievements and Platinum Roadmap
sources.note: Six-step roadmap; 100–200 hours; 11 story hidden trophies plus the gold.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.text: Finish all five chapters as Jason and Lucia. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — it is the one thing that can disappear. Scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars as you go; both count toward 100% later. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (15 manual slots, 1 autosave) because there is no mission replay. Leave cheats off: they disable trophies and saving. Start stranger chains as soon as they unlock — Andy is Lucia-only, Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only, Kenton goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 and comes back.

roadmap.title: 100% checklist + 70 of 80 challenges
roadmap.text: After the story the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything; most collectibles are partial (15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 stunts, 30 races, 70 of 80 challenges). Work the checklist and the trophies below fall out of it.

roadmap.title: Strangers & cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish any Strangers & Freaks strands left (they are not needed for 100%), mop up the miscellaneous trophies, then the platinum pops. Nothing in this stage is missable — every quest giver is still around in free roam.

disputes.call: We show 200 as the planning figure and 300 as the cautious one. Either way it is the longest road here.
Both numbers are printed by the same guides — the trophy and the checklist appear to count different things. Do all 18 and both are covered.

a.claim: 2 ranges: Rodgers Ranch (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin (Balsero)

disputes.call: Unresolved. The 42 gold medals are agreed by both; the location count is not. Use the in-game map (Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges) rather than either number.

disputes.topic: Which chapter is the final mission?

a.claim: The final mission ends the story; Beebom and CULTR call it Chapter 5

b.claim: PowerPyx's table ties the gold to 'Starting From Zero', the Chapter 4 finale

disputes.call: The official description only says 'the final mission'. It pops when the story ends — the chapter label does not change what you do.

disputes.topic: Do stranger chains have story windows?

a.claim: TechWiser: the chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress

b.claim: PowerPyx: every trophy-related quest giver is still there after the story in free roam

disputes.call: Only one source warns of windows, so we list it as a watch item, not a rule: start chains when they unlock, and you are safe either way.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this pops on its own. No online play and no DLC needed. [2]

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies — story, side quests, collectibles, activities, crime and misc — and the platinum unlocks automatically.
It is single-player only: no multiplayer and no DLC is required.
Plan on roughly 200 hours (PowerPyx, KeenGamer); Push Square warns it can run past 300. Difficulty is rated 4/10 — long, not hard.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed. [2]

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when it ends.
Story trophy — automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1 — it pops when you start the first mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?'. [2]

steps.t: Play through Chapter 1 to the end.
It unlocks as Chapter 2 opens, with the mission 'What's in the Bag?'.
Before Chapter 1 ends, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) — the one missable-adjacent moment in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 — it pops when Chapter 3 opens with 'Welcome to Vice City'. [2]

steps.t: Play through Chapter 2 to the end.
It unlocks as Chapter 3 opens, with the mission 'Welcome to Vice City'.
Chapter 2 is where you unlock both-characters play (after 'Coffee Break'), the Scooter Bros app and the Vice City Real Estate app — use them from here on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 — it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. [2]

steps.t: Play through Chapter 3 to the end.
It unlocks after the first two Chapter 4 missions, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'.
Chapter 3 unlocks the Key Cloner (mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs'), Yasmani's jewelry jobs and the Snap Gun — all three feed later trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 — it pops after the Chapter 4 finale, 'Starting From Zero'. [2]

steps.t: Play through Chapter 4 to the end.
It unlocks after the final Chapter 4 mission, 'Starting From Zero'.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy. Finish the story's final mission. Sources disagree on the chapter label (Chapter 5 per Beebom/CULTR, 'Starting From Zero' per PowerPyx) — the official description only says 'the final mission', and it pops when the story ends. [2] [5]

steps.t: Play the story to its final mission and finish it.
After the credits you keep free roam — everything else on this list can still be done.

Chapter label dispute: Beebom and CULTR describe the finale as Chapter 5, while PowerPyx's table ties this trophy to 'Starting From Zero', the Chapter 4 finale. We show both; it changes nothing you do.

trophies.note: Sources disagree on the chapter label — see Disputes.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Automatic. [2]

steps.t: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run to the end.
Story trophy — automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic. [2]

steps.t: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist to the end.
Story trophy — automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Automatic. [2]

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play to the end.
Story trophy — automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Automatic. [2]

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners to the end.
Story trophy — automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic. [2]

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown to the end.
Story trophy — automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic. [2]

steps.t: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory to the end.
Story trophy — automatic, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold. Finish the 100% Completion Checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, unlocked after the story). The bar is lenient — about 60% of true completion — and nothing on it is missable. Hardest trophy in the set. [2] [3]

steps.t: Finish the story first. The checklist only appears after the credits, but progress you made during the story already counts.

Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list: 100 optional missions, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, 30 races, 70 of 80 challenges.
Only five things need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Everything else is partial.
Nothing toward 100% is missable — all of it can be done in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. [2] [3]

steps.t: Do any mix of the four kinds until you hit 250 of 397: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Fastest route: fly under bridges — 202 of them, and PowerPyx calls them the quickest to clear.
Track by region at Progress > Activities > Stunts (R3 for the region view), and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
For 100% you need 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you want A Long Road too.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race/drone race, and performing a stunt. You will do most of them naturally. [2]

steps.t: Do one of each of the 9 types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car, race challenge or drone race), and performing a stunt.
Check what you have done at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities — scrolling over each type shows your count.
Activities are marked with blue dumbbell icons on the map; filter the map for Activities to find them.
Most types come up on their own while you work the other trophies, so leave this for the cleanup pass if it has not popped.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges are listed in-game under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Push Square names 2 ranges, PowerPyx's companion guide lists 12 locations — the 42 medals are agreed, the location count is not. [2] [3]

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Find ranges on the map via Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Push Square names Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero).
Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold, and some stay locked until you meet other conditions shown on the map.
Location count is disputed: PowerPyx's companion guide is titled '12 Shooting Range Locations', Push Square says 2. Trust the in-game map, not either number.

trophies.note: Sources disagree on how many range locations exist — see Disputes.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races across them, per PowerPyx). Some charge an entry fee. [2] [3]

steps.t: Win one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations.
PowerPyx counts 42 races across those 14 spots; you need a win at every location, not every race.
Some locations charge an entry fee — bring cash.
Find discovered locations at Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count. Most spots let you hire a car; check its Rating, and buy upgrades at Mod Shops if you bring your own. [3]

steps.t: Win 20 different races. Winning the same race twice only counts once.
There are 40 unique race locations (PowerPyx), so you have twice as many to choose from as you need.
Most race spots let you hire a car. If you use your own, mind its Rating — Mod Shops sell the upgrades that raise it.
Track them at Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.
For 100% you need 30 race wins, so keep racing past 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui' (meet Cal), Cal texts you asking for a Parrotfish over 2kg. Fish at the marked spot west of Key Lento from a boat with a rod. [2] [3]

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui' where you meet Cal, wait for his text — it marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon.
He wants a Parrotfish over 2kg. Fish in the marked area until you land one that size.
You need a boat and a fishing rod — hijack a boat in the area if you do not own one.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind (all playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1) or Bang For Your Buck (arcade machines around the world). You only need to reach the end, not beat every challenge. [2]

steps.t: Pick any of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are playable on the TV in your home — interact with the controllers. Doable from Chapter 1, though the TV is briefly unavailable during some story sections.
Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world.
To 'complete' a game, finish all its levels at least once. You do not need to beat all of its challenges.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Andy's quests. The chain is Lucia-only: it starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. Quests stay available after the story. [2]

steps.t: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3. Andy calls, then texts her home address — the chain marks itself on the map in Belville.
This chain is Lucia-only. Jason cannot start it.

Complete the 5 Andy quests: 'Climbing the Cellerichain' (parts 1–3), 'Pay the Cellerica Fee', 'Peach!' (join the Cellerica initiation), 'Read the Label' (retrieve the Cellerica van), 'Puff Puff Pass' (meet at the warehouse). The trophy pops after the last one.
Watch item: one source warns stranger chains may have story-progress windows, another says all quest givers return after the story. Start it in Chapter 3 and the question goes away.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear Kenton's 7 shipwreck treasure dives. The chain starts in Chapter 1 after 'Island Dreams'; Kenton goes unavailable for a while, then returns in Chapters 2–3. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. [2]

steps.t: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Island Dreams' (work for Kenton), he calls and marks himself with a green 'KR' icon in Key Lento.
He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map. Dive for the treasure at each shipwreck — a metal detector helps dig it from the ocean floor — and bring it back.
After the first set he calls you back to his shop, then marks more spots. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared.
Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3 (as Jason he texts you; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up). Not missable.
Track it at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees, and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.note: Watch list: Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Billy's quests. The chain marks itself after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All quests stay available after the story. [2]

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', Billy's chain marks itself at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.

Complete the 5 Billy quests: 'Thrillbillies' (check out the mud club), 'Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab', 'Mall Rats', 'The Impaler' (steal the Impaler), 'Hometown Heroes'. The trophy pops after the last one.
All his quests are still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Finish 8 stranger strands — but only certain questlines count. Confirmed: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count. [2]

steps.t: Only certain strands count toward this trophy. Confirmed so far: Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete.
Kirk: 'Search for the Skunk Ape' (Skunk Apeology 101), 'Search for Tree Effigies', 'Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove' (Advanced Skunk Apeonomics).

Kyle: 'Check Out McKittrick Farm', 'Collect Chemicals for Kyle', 'Buddy?' (check on Kyle). Yago: 'Join a Street Race', 'Bumper to Bumper', 'Race Against Yago', 'Brother to Brother'. Pilot Pete: 'The Last Mile' quests and his deliveries.
Do NOT count on Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie — the game does not count them as 'strangers' for this trophy.
More counting strangers are still being found — the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.

trophies.note: Watch list: TechWiser warns stranger chains may have story-progress windows (single source) — see Disputes.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List. The chain starts in Chapter 3 after 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs' — that mission hands you the Key Cloner and the first car, a Granforma Zorrusso. Deliveries still work after the story. [2]

steps.t: During the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs' you steal a Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for high-end sports cars.
Randy then gives you a list of 16 sports cars. Track it at Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he is marked with a green 'RK' icon in west Vice City.
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK (hold Up) to check if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage. Delivering it in good condition pays more.

The 16 cars: Granforma Zorrusso (delivered in the story mission), Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee, Gallivanter Baller ST-D.
Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street — they turn up often around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Destroy the Kitty Litter synthetic labs, then finish Tyrone's second quest 'Spin On This'. The chain is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty'. [2]

steps.t: After the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty', purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City.
This chain is Jason-only — Lucia cannot do it.
Go to the labs and destroy them (quest 'Take Out Kitty Litter').
After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, 'Spin On This' (shut down the labs). Finish it and the trophy pops.
All of it is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one possibly missable trophy. Meditate at all 18 spots (10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts +2). Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house the morning after 'Down to Earth' — it disappears when Chapter 1 ends, and whether it is required is still unconfirmed. The last spot needs both-characters play, after 'Coffee Break' in Chapter 2. [2] [4] [5]

steps.t: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — do this first. The morning after the Chapter 1 mission 'Down to Earth', find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house. She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her and choose 'Accept'.

That balcony meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a 'Meditation Spot' like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it. PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy. Safe play: do it.
Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. A meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played.
You can meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts +2 at the same location.
The last spot cannot be done until you can play both characters together, after 'Coffee Break' in Chapter 2.
Track it at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and find discovered spots on the map under Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida.
Note the count dispute: the 100% checklist asks for 15 meditations while the trophy asks for 18. Do all 18 and both are covered.

trophies.note: Open question: whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required is still unconfirmed — both sides are shown under Sources & disputes.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Work Bret Vogel's hunting chain (Jason-only, starts after 'Coffee Break' in Chapter 2). Which animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx says so directly. [2] [5]

steps.t: After the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', play as Jason: Bret Vogel texts you and marks his first quest, 'Veteran Hunted' (meet Bret) in Lummox County. Lucia cannot receive the message.
This chain is Jason-only.
Do Bret's quests: he marks hunting spots with purple icons, you hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason.

On his first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69', retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. One clean shot leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required.
UNCONFIRMED: which animal exactly unlocks the trophy is still being confirmed. Track the chain at Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, all needed for 100%.

trophies.note: UNCONFIRMED: which animal unlocks this is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards you sell at Pawn Shops still count toward progress. [3]

steps.t: Collect every card in any 3 of the 18 sets.
Track progress at Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
Cards you sell at Pawn Shops still count toward your progress, so sell freely.
For 100% you need 15 full sets, so keep collecting past 3.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver. Scan any 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. There are more than 100, so pick whichever you pass. [2] [3]

steps.t: Open the WAiNK app on Jason or Lucia's phone (hold Up) and scan landmarks by holding R1 while looking at them.
Any 100 count: 31 WAiNK landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. There are more than 100 in total.
Track progress at Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
100% also asks for 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and that checklist line finish together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You only need 50 of 80, and 70 for 100% — pick the easiest and leave the hardest. Track them at Progress > Challenges. [2] [3]

steps.t: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game.
View them all at Progress > Challenges — scrolling over one shows a 'Completed' checkmark in the bottom right.
Many complete themselves while you work the other trophies. Leave this for the cleanup pass, then pick the easiest ones left.
For 100% you need any 70 of 80, so the trophy pops on the way to A Long Road.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. Earliest chance is after 'Coffee Break' (Chapter 2), when you can free-roam together. Easiest escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County. It also pops naturally during the big bank vault robberies. [2]

steps.t: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' — that is when you can free-roam together as Jason and Lucia.
Call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then cause chaos until you hit 4 stars.
Escape the red heat zone — not just the flashing blue/red search area, but the red zone itself. The trophy pops when you drive out of it.
Easiest escape: a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
It also comes naturally: the large bank vault robberies (needed for 100%) always trigger 4 stars, so you will likely get it there anyway.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time. The pop is delayed ~30 seconds after leaving the third shop — if it does not come, hit a fourth. Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3, 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'). [2]

steps.t: Wait until after 'Coffee Break' (Chapter 2) so you can switch between both characters and call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Rob 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while the wanted level stays on — keep the flashing red/blue wanted level, not the red heat level.
Gear up first: an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nations, plus Zombix/Adrenaline for healing.
Good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'. Rob a couple of items in each and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs.
The pop is delayed — about half a minute after leaving the third shop. If nothing pops, rob a fourth shop and keep going.
If you leave the first store before police arrive, the chain may not count — stay until they show up.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Scanning with WAiNK is enough — you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan traffic. There are 557 vehicles at launch. [2] [3]

steps.t: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting inside one counts, and so does scanning it — scanning alone is enough.
Fastest method: use WAiNK (hold Up to open it instantly), then look at passing vehicles and hold R1 to scan. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that drives by.
There are 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes).
Track what you have found at Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles — each category shows its totals.
For 100% you need to scan 200 of the 277 base model vehicles, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in one Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). Fill your focus first — food, drinks, washing up, Adrenaline — and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 at a gang operation. Soldiers, police and civilians do not count. [2]

steps.t: Combat Focus: press L3+R3 while aiming a firearm. Time slows and weak spots are highlighted; it drains the purple focus bar under health and stamina.
Fill focus before you start: eat and drink, wash your face or shower at home, and take Adrenaline to stretch the focus window (hold L1, press Triangle).
Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast without missing. An assault rifle like the Duke 556 is more accurate than pistols or SMGs and fires full-auto.
It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang members.
Wear body armor from Ammu-Nations so you can step out of cover and get close.

Focus has 4 levels (Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, purple eye icon). It rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — you will likely reach level 4 naturally, and the trophy gets easier as you do.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — easiest at terminals E3/E4 — and fly at least 1km away. Planes parked on the airfield do not count. [2]

steps.t: Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport). You need a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal, connected to a passenger boarding bridge — planes sitting on the airfield do not count.

Easiest one: the plane at departure terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it; next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane.
Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly away.
The pop is delayed: you must fly 1km (0.6 miles) away from the airport.
You can also walk in through the airport terminal on foot to reach the E3/E4 plane, but crossing the airfield is faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Tanks stand in the south of the base — drive in through the gate or over the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops. [2]

steps.t: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County.
The tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance.
Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' you get the Snap Gun. Break into a jewelry store through the back door with it (do not kick the door), find the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. [2]

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'. It unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies (green icons on the map in unfogged areas).
Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun. The gadget stays in your inventory permanently — no need to equip it. Kicking the door trips the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. Also destroy the security footage and disable the alarm while you are there.
The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.
Good location: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver. Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults. Start with the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (wait at the cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open. After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each. Each vault pays up to $205,000 and triggers 4 stars. [2]

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (wait at the cafe). It is marked automatically from story progress and teaches the method: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then go in while the vault is open and rob it.
Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone. Hold Right to hand off a bag.

After that mission, pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) $10,000 per tip about security vans. You must first finish his earlier quests (robbing 2 Payday Loans). Tips mark vans with a purple icon — follow them to the bank.
Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults. For 100% you need all 8, so this pops on the way.
Every vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level. Escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch to another vehicle to become unrecognizable.
This is the best money in the endgame — up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault in the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' counts as robbing an armored truck — that is the automatic route. Earlier option: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, then escape the red heat radius. [2]

steps.t: Automatic route: do the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck.
Earlier route: find an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
The trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius — use a Pay 'n' Spray if you need to cool off fast.
Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Yasmani unlocks as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs'.
You need all 8 large bank jobs for 100% anyway, so this pops on the way if you take the automatic route.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. Fastest way is by plane — fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is visible. [2] [5]

steps.t: Unfog the entire map of Leonida. Any area still covered in black fog does not count.
Fastest method: take a plane and fly over all the fogged areas until the whole map is visible.
Exploring on foot and by car works too, but takes far longer — save this for the cleanup pass with a plane.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 in total, and 100% needs all of them — so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them. [2] [5]

steps.t: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
There are 39 illegal gang operations in total. For 100% you need all 39, so keep going past one per gang.
Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress.
Track per-gang progress at Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED steps — PowerPyx reports: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar. eGamers still lists the steps as unconfirmed, so treat this as reported, not proven. [2] [5]

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — reported by PowerPyx, still listed as unconfirmed by eGamers. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar and the trophy should unlock.

trophies.note: UNCONFIRMED: steps reported by one guide, still unconfirmed in another.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED steps — PowerPyx reports: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City (only possible after the Key Cloner from Chapter 3, 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs') and drive it straight through the showroom window. eGamers still lists the steps as unconfirmed. [2] [5]

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — reported by PowerPyx, still listed as unconfirmed by eGamers. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs' (steal the Zorrusso for Randy).
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee with the Key Cloner.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window. The pop is slightly delayed — it comes after you drive further away on the street.
Only the blue Banshee works, not any other car. It is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.note: UNCONFIRMED: steps reported by one guide, still unconfirmed in another.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — sticky bombs open it. It pops after you escape the police. Missed items can be grabbed later when the icon respawns. [2]

steps.t: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'.
Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first; you need them to blow the safe.

Inside, steal the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon), the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office.
The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. Killing the enemies is not necessary.
Not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for what is left.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out together — while one trains, the other progresses too. Only possible after 'Coffee Break' (Chapter 2), when you can switch characters. [2]

steps.t: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check levels at Touch Pad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', when you can switch between both characters.

Raise Strength by working out. Buy a membership at a fitness club — filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City. You can also work out at home after the story.
Always train together: call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). While you actively work out with one character, the other completes their training automatically — double progress.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count. It happens passively through robberies and fights — turn on profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to watch it climb. Single-source figure (GTABase via eGamers; PowerPyx agrees). [2] [5]

steps.t: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see how many of 500 you have done.

Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile. Whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right of the screen.

Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing many cops and civilians, driving over gravestones), and Irredeemable — permanent if you keep up excessive violence.
It comes passively: every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is your last trophy, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
Warning: at Psycho or Irredeemable, cops are more likely to shoot on sight — and Irredeemable is permanent, so do not push that far unless you have to.

trophies.note: Single-source count (500): GTABase via eGamers, echoed by PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has a proven method yet. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner, in Little Cuba, Vice City. Do not chase this one until a method is confirmed. [2] [5]

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED. PowerPyx: 'This trophy is currently unknown (believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from Prologue, possibly robbing it later again in a specific manner, it is located in Vice City – Little Cuba).'
eGamers lists it as unconfirmed too. No second source has a method.
Our advice: leave it until a guide confirms a method. Robbing the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba again is the only lead — try it late, when you have nothing else left.

trophies.note: UNCONFIRMED: no proven method. Best lead is the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx reports a UFO easter egg: road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, solo. If a blinking car is at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it, talk to the woman it drops and help her back to her car. The spawn is slightly random. eGamers still lists it unconfirmed. [2] [5]

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — reported in detail by PowerPyx, still listed as unconfirmed by eGamers. Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside. It is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn — if it is not there, drive away and come back.
Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods. You will see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky).
Approach it: the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her and offer to help. She asks you to go back to her car at the roadside — do that and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.note: UNCONFIRMED: method reported by one guide, still unconfirmed in another. Spawn is random.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED steps — PowerPyx reports: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds, in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach. eGamers still lists the steps as unconfirmed. [2] [5]

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED — reported by PowerPyx, still listed as unconfirmed by eGamers. Ride any bike.
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.
Do it somewhere crowded, like Vice City or Ocean Beach.

trophies.note: UNCONFIRMED: steps reported by one guide, still unconfirmed in another.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through fences — cumulative, not in one trip. First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check' (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the bills to a fence. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. [2]

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission 'Credit Check' (meet Raul's crew). It unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
You need $250,000 delivered in total — it counts across all robberies, not in one trip.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery within a few minutes, but they only unlock after the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'.
It comes naturally while you do all the robberies for 100%.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items. Find shops on the map via Touch Pad > Style. [2] [3]

steps.t: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. Anything counts.
Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive things in the game.
Shops in the game: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores.
Find shops on the map by pressing Touch Pad > Style.
It adds up on its own while you buy guns, upgrades and clothes for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver'. The 4 story garages do not count. [2] [3]

steps.t: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. They cost $160,000 in total.
Garages unlock for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver' (steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone.

Buy them through the phone app (press Up, open Vice City Real Estate). The 8: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800.
The 4 story-related garages do not count toward this trophy.
Garages store vehicles you register at a Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop, and each adds parking spots you need for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses' — drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray' then 'Register'. Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down. [2] [3]

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses' (take a vehicle to Moses). It delivers your registered vehicles to your location for a small fee.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn. In his garage choose 'Respray' and then 'Register'.
At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Register 10 different vehicles. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
You need enough parking spots first — buy garages (see Little Boxes); each garage adds spots.
